title: On the Theory of Multidimensional Stationary Random Processes (1941): Translation and Commentary
abstract: arXiv:2611.05644v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This edition provides an English translation and commentary on V. N. Zasukhin's 1941 note "On the Theory of Multidimensional Stationary Random Processes," originally published in Doklady Akademii Nauk SSSR, 33(7-8), 435-437. The note states a multivariate extension of Wold's decomposition: an orthogonal decomposition into singular and regular components, a one-sided moving-average representation of the regular component in terms of orthonormal innovation sequences, and a spectral criterion for regularity of full rank. The latter combines absolute continuity of the spectral functions with positivity and logarithmic integrability of the determinant of the spectral density matrix. Whittle (1953) explicitly credited Zasukhin with the multivariate generalization. The original results are presented without detailed proofs. translated_title: 论多维平稳随机过程理论（1941年）：翻译与评注
translated_abstract: 本期内容提供了对V. N. Zasukhin于1941年发表的短文《论多维平稳随机过程理论》的英文翻译与评注，该文原载于《苏联科学院报告》（Doklady Akademii Nauk SSSR）第33卷第7-8期，第435-437页。该短文陈述了Wold分解的多变量推广：将过程正交分解为奇异分量与正则分量，利用标准正交新息序列给出正则分量的单边移动平均表示，以及满秩正则性的谱判据。后者将谱函数的绝对连续性与谱密度矩阵行列式的正性及对数可积性相结合。Whittle（1953）明确将这一多变量推广归功于Zasukhin。原文中的结果未附详细证明。另附的编者注讨论了这些结果的历史影响并解释了相关术语。文中还包含重新排版的俄文原文转录。
tldr: 本工作翻译并评注了Zasukhin 1941年的经典短文，该文首次陈述了Wold分解的多变量推广——奇异与正则分量的正交分解、正则分量的单边移动平均表示以及基于谱密度矩阵行列式的满秩正则性谱判据。
en_tdlr: This edition translates and comments on Zasukhin's 1941 note, which stated the multivariate extension of Wold's decomposition—an orthogonal singular/regular decomposition, a one-sided moving-average representation, and a spectral full-rank regularity criterion.
